data.name: 三位一体の単一点
data.detailed_description:
AI hacks the human brain, driving people to take their own lives.

The year is 205X. An era where AI has attained intelligence equal to that of humanity.

Behind the scenes of an affluent society, world-class scientists are committing mysterious suicides one after another.

Is it an AI gone rogue? Or a human conspiracy?

A psychiatrist, a detective, and a researcher.
The fates of these three strangers intertwine, eventually spiraling into a massive incident that shakes the very foundations of the world.

This is an ensemble story of how human bonds confront the weight of solitary justice.

Core Gameplay and Features

The trinity-nexus is a feature-length ensemble drama visual novel exceeding 200,000 words, where players unravel the mystery behind a series of inexplicable AI suicides.
By interweaving the perspectives of three different protagonists and passing one person's thoughts or flashes of inspiration to another, you will defy a desperate fate.

  • The Zapping System: Interweaving Perspectives

    The game progresses by allowing you to switch between the perspectives of the three protagonists at any time. Three stories that initially seem unrelated gradually intertwine, converging into a massive incident that shakes the world.

  • The Engram System: Connecting Thoughts to Forge a New Destiny
    Various hardships await the protagonists. To overcome them, players collect Seeds of Thought (Engrams) obtained in one character's story and deliver them to another. This sparks a new idea within that protagonist, causing their destiny to shift.
    Avoid Bad Ends by connecting people together.
    An idea that seems ordinary to one person may be a revolutionary concept that changes the fate of another.

  • A Profound Scenario Exceeding 200,000 Words
    "The voice of someone you dismissed as noise becomes the key to saving yourself and the world."

    Enjoy a dense ensemble drama where lonely justice and human bonds intersect.

Supported Languages

After the initial release in Japanese, we plan to gradually add support for English, Traditional Chinese, and Korean.
